args.intent: Revenue Reporting Policy net revenue completed orders definition

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'North'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2025

transcript.text:
Data covers all of 2025 already. The result: net_cents = 23,940,208 → $239,402.08.

Let me capture this knowledge for future reuse.

args.content: Computed: total net revenue (amount - discount, completed orders only) for the anchor region (North, per memory.bench.customers.region joined to memory.bench.orders) in calendar year 2025 = $239,402.08 (23,940,208 cents over 210 completed orders). Used memory.bench.orders directly (not daily_region_revenue, which is gross-only and only covers through 2025-11-30).
